review:
Feel the Beat is a 5x5 party slot where the Speaker symbol does the heavy lifting. When speakers land on at least two different reels, every winning payline that connects them is highlighted, and all symbols on those lines, including wilds, FS symbols and the speakers themselves, flip into the same paying symbol.

Two speakers on the same reel don't activate, so position matters. The flip can turn a small connection into several full lines at once. The visuals are bright, with a pulsing soundtrack, and the 10,000x maximum is available in every mode, including the free spins rounds. Worth a few demo spins just to watch how the speaker lines resolve.
